thoughts.sr: SEPA je registrovala 32 instrumenta sa PM10 koji su pevali na 163 µg/m³ u Danijelovu, dok je NO2 dostigao 65 µg/m³ u Obrenovcu Centar. Informacioni tok grada sadrži 235 naslova, iako danas nije prijavljeno nikakvo saobraćajno nesreća. [F2][F4][F6][F44][F43]
thoughts.en: SEPA registered 32 instruments [F2] with PM10 peaking at 163 µg/m³ at Danijelova [F4], while NO2 reached 65 µg/m³ at Obrenovac Centar [F6]. The city's news feed contains 235 headlines [F44], yet no traffic accidents were reported today [F43].

thoughts.sr: SEPA je pre primila 32 instrumenta pre 19 minuta sa PM10 koji su dostigli vrhunac od 101 µg/m³ na Omladinskih brigada, dok je NO2 dostigao 115 µg/m³ na Bulevar despota Stefana. Građanski senzori su prijavili veći volumen podataka u istom periodu, što sugeriše širu pokrivenost nadzora nego zvanične stanice. [F2][F4][F6][F10]
thoughts.en: SEPA received 32 instruments 19 min ago [F2] with PM10 peaking at 101 µg/m³ at Omladinskih brigada [F4], while NO2 reached 115 µg/m³ at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6]. Citizen sensors reported a higher data volume in the same period [F10], suggesting broader monitoring coverage than official stations.
hypotheses: perhaps the rise in PM10 at Omladinskih brigada correlates with industrial activity given its proximity to heavy industry zones
if traffic accidents were reported today, they might explain the NO2 spike at Bulevar despota Stefana
questions: are there any traffic accidents linked to Bulevar despota Stefana in the open data?
do industrial zones near Omladinskih brigada show higher emissions than residential areas?
hypotheses_sr: možda je porast PM10-a na Omladinskih brigada koreliran sa industrijskom delatnošću s obzirom na njegovu blizinu teško industrijskim zonama
ako su danas prijavljene saobraćajne nesreće, one bi mogle objasniti skok NO2-a na Bulevar despota Stefana
questions_sr: da li postoje saobraćajne nesreće povezane sa Bulevar despota Stefana u otvorenim podacima?
da li industrijske zone blizu Omladinskih brigada pokazuju veće emisije od stambenih zona?

thoughts.en: Citizen sensors report 52 instruments [F10], a volume exceeding SEPA's 32 instruments by nearly half, yet official stations show no surge in values despite perceived noise.
hypotheses: maybe citizen sensors amplify data because they lack calibration filters like SEPA does
perhaps the high headline count on B92 and Cenzolovka reflects a specific event not yet in official air quality reports
questions: what is the correlation between sensor counts and headline volume for similar events?
are citizen sensors filtering out background noise while SEPA stations are saturated?

možda visok broj naslova na B92 i Cenzolovka odražava specifičan događaj koji još nije u zvaničnim izveštajima o kvalitetu vazduha
questions_sr: kako je korelacija između broja senzora i volumena naslova za slične događaje?
da li građanski senzori filtruju pozadinski buku dok su SEPA stanice zasićene?
